# Cardo Systems

> Manufacturer of premium Bluetooth motorcycle and outdoor helmet communication systems including Packtalk Pro, Packtalk Edge, Freecom 4x, and BEYOND smart helmets with DMC technology.

Cardo Systems has been a leader in wireless communication for riders since 2003, offering headsets, speakers, and accessories for motorcycle, off-road, and outdoor enthusiasts. Their flagship products feature DMC (Dynamic Mesh Communication) technology and integrate with the Cardo Connect app for firmware updates and device management.

## Key Topics

- Packtalk Pro
- Packtalk Edge
- Freecom 4x
- BEYOND smart helmet
- Packtalk Outdoor
- DMC Gen2 (Dynamic Mesh Communication)
- Cardo Connect app
- Spirit HD
- Bluetooth helmet communication
- Motorcycle intercom systems
- Off-road communication
- Firmware updates
- Outdoor headsets
- Crash detection technology
